articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Where DeFi yield really comes from (and why it broke this spring)
articles.snippet: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, Solstice Finance's David Plisek argues that most of the money lost in DeFi this spring wasn't taken by hackers but by yield strategies that quietly stopped working. Looking at April's $13 billion drawdown, he shows that a headline yield number reveals almost nothing about whether it will hold under stress, laying out four questions an allocator should ask before committing capital.

articles.snippet: The investment bank will help its roughly 3,000 institutional clients execute large block trades in event contracts.

articles.title: A year after losing $1.46 billion, Bybit says AI helped it save $700 million
articles.snippet: The exchange that lost $1.46 billion to North Korean hackers is the first large centralized firm to put numbers on a claim bitcoin developers have been making all month.
